title: Find the K-th Character in String Game I
sources: https://leetcode.com/problems/find-the-k-th-character-in-string-game-i/ (official page returns 403 to fetch; link from web search)
accessAttempt: Constraint and examples from the doocs mirror.
summary: Starting from 'a', repeatedly append a copy shifted to the next letter (z wraps to a); return the k-th character.
visualizationNotes: Visualization shows the built word with pages of 32 characters; k capped at 500 by the official constraint.
